title: Flight Progression Matrix
description: Definition of modules and qualification gates driving the non-linear pilot training syllabus.

modules.name: FPV Initiation Protocol
objectives: Distinguish manual flight vs stabilized flight
Identify pilot class archetypes

modules.name: Virtual Muscle Memory Calibration
objectives: Thread 5 coordinate gaps in Acro mode
Complete 20 flight hours virtually

modules.name: Radio Transmitter & Link Quality
objectives: Configure a custom binding phrase in ELRS
Distinguish 2.4GHz vs 915MHz frequency propagation

modules.name: Video Goggles & Ecosystem Selection
objectives: Evaluate latency differences between digital ecosystems
Distinguish video receiver antenna polarization patterns

modules.name: LiPo Chemistry and Storage Safety
objectives: Recognize safe battery voltage thresholds per cell
Demonstrate understanding of storage charging guidelines

modules.name: Motor Physics & KV Calculations
objectives: Map appropriate motor stator sizes to target voltage categories
Calculate static thrust-to-weight metrics for prop dimensions

modules.name: Electrical Soldering & Smoke Stopper Controls
objectives: Perform mechanical joint solder bonds on flight control pads
Implement current protection rules on first power-up connection

modules.name: Dynamic PID Controls & Vibration Noise Filtering
objectives: Distinguish Proportional, Integral, and Derivative gains
Activate RPM filtering utilizing dynamic bidirectional DShot

modules.name: Pre-flight Inspections and Video Recovery Checks
objectives: Diagnose dynamic signal dropouts using localized telemetry parameters
Execute a comprehensive pre-arm physical integrity audit

modules.name: GPS Return-To-Home Fail-safe Setup
objectives: Map appropriate fail-safe coordinates to active switches
Calibrate minimal satellite lock configurations for arm validation

qualificationGate.checkpointName: GPS rescue tested on safe arming

modules.name: Cinematic Operator Specialization
objectives: Calibrate gimbal-tilt dynamic fluid response values
Calculate appropriate ND filter indices matching shutter rates

modules.name: Freestyle Proximity Specialization
objectives: Execute low-altitude inverted proximity gap threading
Configure aggressive D-term resonance vibration filters

modules.name: Competitive Racing Specialization
objectives: Maintain minimal gate-apex throttle cornering margins
Flash low-latency custom firmware to 4-in-1 racers

modules.name: Long Range Alpine Exploration
objectives: Map high-altitude mountain signal propagation pathing
Assemble long-endurance high-density Li-Ion cell packs

modules.name: Advanced Systems Integration Specialization
objectives: Analyze telemetry log gyro heat dissipation coefficients
Calibrate dynamic commutation timing parameters in AM32
